what: The FTorch-bound instratus surrogate (TorchScript at the kernel's hook, the image answering inside Fortran) on exclusive main-queue nodes, 50 steps, the p13 image.
outcome: every rank failed in mpi4py before the model was constructed: 'cannot load MPI library' (libfabric.so.1 and libmpi.so not found); 764 tracebacks, walltime 18 s, no history, no summary
bfb_record_note: pi_cam_pausable_instratus-ftorch-excl_vs_oracle_50step_bfb.json and the .health.json were written by the job's comparison of an empty run and are not evidence; the resubmitted run (7392240) reuses the tag and overwrites both.
diagnosis: Not the model path: the failure is in loading the MPI library itself, before any freeCAM code ran, on a node set that included dec0011; the same job script with nothing replaced (7391564) ran and was bit-for-bit one minute earlier on other nodes, and the same command resubmitted (7392240) is the measurement.  A node whose environment lacks libfabric, not a defect in the image or the binding.
